name: Jabari
description: A general of Zhalfir and an old friend of Teferi who brings him to Aku.

timeline.summary: Teferi is reunited with the general Jabari, who has come to bring him to the queen.
timeline.quote: I am just Teferi Akosa now, Jabari,

timeline.summary: Jabari reveals another outsider has come to Zhalfir and asked for Teferi.
timeline.quote: You are not the only one from outside to come here.
